page.html_content: Buffera is clipboard history for Mac. Search by meaning, ask a smart assistant and copy text from screenshots. Keep what you need close at hand.
page.html_content_3: Clipboard history for Mac. With search by meaning, a smart assistant and a softer look.
page.availability_text: For your Mac. And your memory.
page.hero_description_text_2: Easy on the eyes. Search by meaning.
page.sculpture_aria_label: Give Buffera a tap to start the spring animation
page.touch_label_text: Go on. Give them a squeeze.
page.hero_bottom_text: In Russian, we call the clipboard a “buffer”. “Buffera” also means boobs.
page.section_intro_text: A link from yesterday’s chat. Just the right wording. A screenshot with an address. Buffera keeps what you copy, so it’s easy to come back to.
page.section_intro_text_2: Find it in your history. Copy it again.
page.section_intro_text_3: Use it wherever you need it.
page.demo_fallback_text: Enable JavaScript to try searching the examples. This demo doesn’t read your history.
page.detail_note_text: This is a demo item. Your clipboard hasn’t changed.
page.feature_copy_text_3: Buffera searches by meaning. Just describe what you’re looking for, even if the exact words have slipped your mind.
page.chat_question_text: What error did I copy yesterday?
page.chat_answer_text_2: Here’s the item and its context.
page.feature_copy_text_6: Ask about what you’ve copied. Your smart assistant helps you find what you need and make sense of saved snippets.
page.feature_note_text_2: Apple Silicon · available after downloading the model
page.mini_feature_text_3: Search images by the text inside and copy that text on its own. No more retyping addresses, quotes or notes.
page.mini_feature_text_6: Remove unwanted formatting, duplicate lines, line breaks and tracking parameters in links. Make JSON easier to read, too.
page.mini_feature_text_9: See what you copied before and after an item. Revisit your work and find related snippets.
page.wrap_text_3: Three steps. No hunting through tabs.
page.privacy_copy_text: Your data stays on your Mac — Buffera doesn’t send it anywhere. Search by meaning, text recognition and the smart assistant run locally, too.
page.privacy_copy_text_2: Hide sensitive text from view and search.
page.privacy_copy_text_3: History isn’t recorded while your Mac is locked or asleep.
page.privacy_copy_text_4: Pause recording. Delete what you don’t need. Set your limits.
page.fine_print_text: Hiding an item masks it; it doesn’t encrypt it separately. External AI agents can access your history only with your permission and may send data to their services.
page.details_grid_text_2: Save important items to favorites. Keep useful text and links within reach, safe from automatic history cleanup.
page.details_grid_text_4: Copy something again and it moves to the top instead of creating a duplicate. Text, images and file references all stay in one history.
page.details_grid_text_6: Search just images, items from a particular app or copies from a certain day. Less clutter, less searching.
page.details_grid_text_8: A list or a grid, a window or a side panel. Make Buffera your own and pin it above other windows when you need it. Available in English and Russian.
page.details_grid_text_10: Open long text and images in a full preview. Save an image to a file or reveal it in Finder.
page.details_grid_text_12: Find items received through Apple’s Universal Clipboard separately from things copied on your Mac.
page.details_grid_text_14: Codex, Claude Code and other AI agents can search your clipboard history. Connect yours through MCP and find what you need right in the conversation.
page.details_grid_text_16: By default, Buffera waits until your Mac is plugged in before preparing smart search in the background.
page.details_grid_text_18: Choose how much history to keep. The default is up to 50,000 items and 5 GB, with favorites kept outside those limits.
page.wrap_text_4: Keep your head free for ideas.
page.install_card_text_2: Open the DMG and drag Buffera into Applications.
page.install_card_text_3: What do the smart features need?
page.install_card_text_4: A Mac with Apple Silicon and a separate model download when you first enable them. After that, search by meaning and the assistant work offline.
page.build_badge_label: Made with OpenAI GPT Astra in Ultra mode
page.build_badge_link: About Astra on OpenAI’s website — opens in a new tab
page.og_image_alt: Buffera — nice buffers. Great memory. Clipboard history for Mac.
page.install_first_launch_title: If macOS blocks the first launch
page.install_first_launch_text: This first release isn’t notarized by Apple yet. After trying to launch it, open System Settings → Privacy & Security and choose Open Anyway for Buffera.
page.demo_semantic_hint: Try “address”: with this checked, you’ll find the screenshot of the meeting place. The demo matches curated example topics.
page.support_hint: Support development on Tribute — opens in a new tab
page.support_note: Give your favorite clipboard a little love.
